info.name: Apache ZooKeeper Admin Server Cluster Monitoring API

items.docs: Returns information about all client connections. Equivalent to the 'cons' four-letter-word command.
Resets all connection statistics. Equivalent to the 'crst' command.

info.name: Apache ZooKeeper List Sessions and Ephemeral Nodes

items.docs: Lists the outstanding sessions and ephemeral nodes. Equivalent to the 'dump' four-letter-word command.
Lists brief details for the server and connected clients. Equivalent to the 'stat' four-letter-word command.

info.name: Apache ZooKeeper Get Full Server Details

items.docs: Lists full details for the server. Equivalent to the 'srvr' four-letter-word command.
Resets server statistics. Equivalent to the 'srst' command.
Returns a list of variables for monitoring the health of the cluster. Equivalent to the 'mntr' four-letter-word command.

info.name: Apache ZooKeeper Get Data Tree Digest

items.docs: Returns the digest of the data tree.

info.name: Apache ZooKeeper Get Last Snapshot Info

items.docs: Returns information about the last snapshot taken.
